episodes.title: Once Bitten, Twice Shy
episodes.summary: Jay and Nya cut their date short, as the Serpentine are on their way to regain Fangblades to wake the Great Devourer.

episodes.title: All of Nothing
episodes.imageAlt: The Rise of the Great Devourer

episodes.title: The Curse of the Golden Master
Infamous
episodes.summary: After destroying the Cursed Realm and saving Ninjago,the Ninja have discovered new-found fame;a new evil named Nadakhan the Djinn is freedand a new age of piracy has begun.

episodes.title: Public Enemy Number One
episodes.summary: The Ninja must find out as much as they can about Nadakhan before he finds the Realm Crystal to save his crew; the Ninja are labeled enemies by the world they used to protect and find themselves hunted by their old friend, Ronan.

episodes.title: Enkrypted
episodes.summary: Falsely imprisoned and at their lowest point, the Ninja find an unlikely friend in an old enemy; Nadakhan rescues his marooned crew and gains a new perspective.

episodes.title: Misfortune Rising
episodes.summary: Jay makes a wish to change his future as the Ninja search for Nadakhan.
episodes.imageAlt: On a Wish and a Prayer

episodes.title: On a Wish and a Prayer
episodes.summary: The Ninja set course to a dangerous island to find the only thing that can stop Nadakhan. Meanwhile, the Sky Pirates learn about the master plan, and a deep secret of the Ninja is exposed.

episodes.title: My Dinner with Nadakhan
episodes.summary: Held captive on Misfortune's Keep, Jay is tested as Azad does everything in his power to break his will to say his final wish. Meanwhile, the marooned Ninja attempt to escape the island.

episodes.title: Wishmasters
episodes.summary: The last remaining Ninja dare to infiltrate the Sky Pirates in an attempt to save Jay and defeat Nadakhan once and for all.

episodes.title: The Last Resort
episodes.summary: When the last two remaining Ninja are safe-guarded in a place no one would dare to look, the Sky Pirates discover their whereabouts and attack in search of the one who holds the power to unlock Azad's full potential.

episodes.title: Operation Land Ho!
episodes.summary: The last remaining ninja gets help from old allies to help him stop Nadakhan's ceremonial wedding from taking place.

episodes.title: The Way Back
episodes.summary: When Nadakhan acquires infinite wishes, Jay only has one.

episodes.title: Hands of Time
episodes.summary: Master Wu engages in a battle with one of the twin Hands of Time, but the Ninja arrive at the monastery just in time.

episodes.title: The Hatching
episodes.summary: The Ninja learn more about Krux and Acronix, two fallen Elemental Masters, and discover a new enemy, the Vermillion Warriors.

episodes.title: A Time of Traitors
episodes.summary: Kai's investigation of a Vermillion Warrior helmet leads him to discover that Krux is alive, and living under an assumed identity.

episodes.title: Scavengers
episodes.summary: While the Vermillion Warriors are responsible for a metal theft spree, Lloyd learns that taking over for Master Wu is not an easy task.

episodes.title: A Line in the Sand
episodes.summary: The Ninja try to save MegaMonster Amusement Park; Jay defends his family's home against Vermillion Warriors.

episodes.title: The Attack
episodes.summary: The team celebrates their escape from the Vermillion Army, but Acronix and Krux are determined to get their Blade back.

episodes.title: Secrets Discovered
episodes.summary: Nya confronts the Samurai X imposter; Kai pursues the truth about his parents; the others try to locate and rescue Master Wu.

episodes.title: Pause and Effect
episodes.summary: Kai confronts his father for aiding the Hands of Time; the team works to free Wu, Cyrus Borg and the other captives.
episodes.imageAlt: Out of the Fire and Into the Boiling Sea

episodes.title: Out of the Fire and Into the Boiling Sea
episodes.summary: Kai and Nya are blackmailed into using their elemental powers to retrieve the final Time Blade from the Boiling Sea.

episodes.title: Lost in Time
episodes.summary: Kai and Nya stow away with the Hands of Time to save Master Wu, and must help the Elemental Masters prevent Krux and Acronix from re-writing NinjaGo history.

episodes.title: The Darkness Comes
episodes.summary: The Oni have returned and are destroying the realms.

episodes.title: Wasted True Potential
episodes.summary: In the wake of the previous season's victory, the ninja have gone soft and Master Wu must remind them of who they truly are.

episodes.title: Questing for Quests
episodes.summary: Realizing they have gone soft, the ninja search for a quest to reignite their Spinjitzu training. Unfortunately, NINJAGO City is enjoying a period of rare tranquility.

episodes.title: A Rocky Start
episodes.summary: The ninja have found their quest! Now they just have to get there, which involves a road trip through the Desert of Doom, a region supposedly inhabited by a giant scarab beetle.

episodes.title: The Belly of the Beast
episodes.summary: To repair the Land-Bounty, the ninja must retrieve a critical engine component that has been swallowed by a giant scarab beetle.
episodes.imageAlt: Boobytraps and How to Survive Them

episodes.title: Booby-Traps, and How to Survive Them
episodes.summary: The ninja team up with a reluctant Clutch Powers to enter a mysterious pyramid where they inadvertently unleash an ancient evil.

episodes.title: The News Never Sleeps!
episodes.summary: Lil' Nelson takes a job as a paperboy, which is more difficult than it sounds in a city overrun by scorching Pyro Vipers and an evil Serpentine sorceress.

episodes.title: Ninja vs. Lava
episodes.summary: The ninjas find themselves trapped in a pyramid and must escape encroaching lava to warn NINJAGO City of a new Serpentine invasion.

episodes.title: Snaketastrophy
episodes.summary: The Serpentine attack on NINJAGO City is seen from an unexpected perspective - entirely in the style of a live newscast delivered by Gayle Gossip and her cameraman.

episodes.title: Powerless
episodes.summary: The ninja rush to the NINJAGO Museum of History to recover a dangerous scroll before it falls into the hands of the Serpentine Sorceress Aspheera.

episodes.title: Ancient History
episodes.summary: While Aspheera pursues revenge on the Treacherous Deceiver who betrayed her, the ninja make a startling discovery.

episodes.title: Never Trust a Human
episodes.summary: A flashback episode tells the story of Young Wu and Young Garmadon meeting Aspheera and teaching her the secrets of Spinjitzu.

episodes.title: Under Siege
episodes.summary: Having learned Master Wu is the "Treacherous One," the ninja find themselves under siege at the Monastery, trying to protect Wu from the wrath of Aspheera.

episodes.title: The Explorer's Club
episodes.summary: The ninja must break into Explorer's Club to obtain the second Scroll of Forbidden Spinjitzu, running afoul of the club's manager and irate club-members.

episodes.title: Vengeance is Mine!
episodes.summary: Aspheera arrives at the Monastery of Spinjitzu and confronts Wu, forcing one of the ninja to make a heroic sacrifice.

episodes.title: A Cold Goodbye
episodes.summary: Having learned Zane is not dead, Master Wu prepares to go after him, but Lloyd and the other ninja take matters into their own hands and defy their Master.

episodes.title: The Kaiju Protocol
episodes.summary: Back in Ninjago City, Wu and Pixal attempt to locate the Never-Realm, and accidentally unleash a dreaded creature from the Departed Realm.

episodes.title: Corruption
episodes.summary: The story of Zane's arrival in the Never-Realm and how he fell under the sway of the villainous Vex.

episodes.title: A Fragile Hope
episodes.summary: Having discovered the terrible truth of Zane's fate, Lloyd finds himself imprisoned and alone in the clutches of the Ice Emperor.

episodes.title: Once and for All
episodes.summary: Nya, Jay, Cole and Kai face off against the Ice Emperor's dreaded dragon, while Lloyd and his newfound allies, Kataru and Grimfax, confront the Ice Emperor himself.

episodes.title: Awakenings
episodes.summary: The dramatic conclusion of the Never-Realm saga, in which old friends are reunited and the power of friendship is pitted against the corrupting power of the Scroll of Forbidden Spinjitzu.
